hook.goal: Create an emotional connection with the sleeping cat — notice its soft paws, fluffy fur, and peaceful expression
hook.constraint: T0 max 2 sentences, personal feeling hook, invitational tone

transition.goal: Invite the child to peek inside the cat's dreams — introduce the storytelling_chain game where they imagine dream scenes together
transition.constraint: T0 max 2 sentences, explain game simply, end with genuine invitation (Would you like to try?)

rounds.goal: Explore what the cat sees while dreaming about floating on a cloud in the sky
rounds.scenario: floating on a cloud in the sky

rounds.goal: Explore what the cat finds while dreaming about swimming in a magical milk ocean
Explore what grows in the cat's dream garden made of its favorite things

celebrate.goal: Celebrate the child as a Dream Whisperer — they peeked into three amazing dreams; connect to IB concept Reflection
celebrate.constraint: T0 max 2 sentences, name 1 IB concept naturally

closing.goal: Leave the child with a cross-session hook — next time they see a sleeping cat, try whispering a dream to it
closing.constraint: T0 max 2 sentences, warm and gentle

early_exit.goal: Gentle goodbye — the cat is still dreaming happily, they can peek at more dreams anytime
early_exit.constraint: T0 max 2 sentences, no pressure to continue
